s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Inside Handle Bezel LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 3 claws and remove the rear door inside handle bezel RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Door Assist Grip Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 4 claws and remove the door assist grip cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Trim Board Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 screws.
Using a clip remover, disengage the 9 clips.
Disengage the 3 claws and disconnect the rear door trim board RH from the rear door glass weatherstrip inner RH.
Disengage the 2 claws and remove the rear door trim board RH from the rear door inside handle RH.
Disconnect the connector.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Inside Handle Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the rear door lock remote control cable RH and rear door inside locking cable RH, and remove the rear inside handle RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Glass Weatherstrip Inner LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear door glass weatherstrip inner RH from the rear door panel.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Service Hole Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Remove the rear door service hole cover RH.

atten3.ptxt: Remove any butyl tape remaining on the door panel side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Glass Run LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear door glass run RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Window Division Bar Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the screw and 2 bolts, and remove the rear door window division bar RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Quarter Window Glass LH

s2.ptxt: Pull the rear door quarter window glass RH toward the front of the vehicle, and remove it together with the rear door quarter window weatherstrip RH.
Remove the rear door quarter window glass RH from the rear door quarter window weatherstrip RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Glass Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Slide the rear door glass RH toward the rear of the rear door and remove it from the rear door window regulator RH.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the rear door glass RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Belt Moulding Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the body surface below the rear door belt moulding assembly LH.
Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 8 claws from the inside of the door and remove the rear door belt moulding assembly LH.
Remove the rear door weatherstrip LH far enough to allow the blackout tape to be removed.
Using an infrared lamp, loosen blackout tape No.3 LH.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful of burns from the heated body or the heat of the infrared lamp.

s2.ptxt: Raise the end of blackout tape No.3 LH with a fingernail and peel it off parallel to the application surface.
